title: Follow-up is a journey, not a chase
learningGoal: Know what needs to happen between an enquiry and a booking.

sections.title: What a Lead Wants to Know

items.title: Did you receive my message?
items.description: A lead wants confirmation that their enquiry was received and is being handled.

items.title: Can you help me?
items.description: They need to know if your service or product fits their specific situation.

items.title: What should I do next?
items.description: A clear next step removes confusion and moves the conversation forward.

items.title: 1. Capture
items.description: A contact submits a form or makes an enquiry.

items.title: 3. Invite
items.description: Offer one clear way to book a call or take the next step.

items.title: 4. Check
items.description: Allow time and check for a reply or booking.

items.title: 5. Follow up
items.description: Send a single relevant reminder if there has been no response or booking.

items.title: Write the exact question
items.description: What is your ideal lead asking when they fill out your form?

items.title: Write one helpful sentence
items.description: Answer that question in a single sentence that reassures and guides them.

keyPoint: A lead wants to know three things: Did you receive my message? Can you help me? What should I do next? The five-step formula is Capture, Respond, Invite, Check, Follow up.

actionSteps.title: Identify your lead's primary question
actionSteps.description: Write the exact question your ideal lead is asking when they fill out your form.

actionSteps.title: Write a one-sentence answer
actionSteps.description: Create one helpful sentence that answers their question and moves them forward.

actionSteps.title: Review the five-step formula
actionSteps.description: Check your current follow-up process against Capture, Respond, Invite, Check, Follow up.

quizzes.question: What are the three things a lead wants to know after submitting an enquiry?

options.option_text: Did you receive my message? Can you help me? What should I do next?
How fast, how cheap, how good
Who are you, what do you do, why should I care

quizzes.explanation: A lead wants to know: Did you receive my message? Can you help me? What should I do next? A useful response answers these three questions without overwhelming them.

quizzes.question: What is the correct order of the five-step follow-up formula?

options.option_text: Invite, Capture, Respond, Check, Follow up
Capture, Respond, Invite, Check, Follow up
Capture, Check, Respond, Invite, Follow up
Respond, Capture, Invite, Follow up, Check

quizzes.explanation: The five-step formula is: 1. Capture (form submission), 2. Respond (acknowledgement), 3. Invite (clear next step), 4. Check (allow time), 5. Follow up (single reminder if needed).

quizzes.question: How many follow-up reminders should you send if there is no response?

options.option_text: As many as it takes until they reply

quizzes.explanation: The formula recommends sending a single relevant reminder if there has been no response or booking. Multiple unsolicited follow-ups can feel like chasing and damage trust.
